label: Single print above
gloss: the low edge of the nearest single-print zone above the price in the current UTC day's letter profile, excluding a zone the price has reached since the fold — read live, because the price decides which zone is nearest — and its dist_tpoSpAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

label: Single print below

label: Naked single print above
